SELECT VARCHAR(a.SPECIFICNAME, 20) AS PUBLIC_EXECUTES, VARCHAR(r.OWNER, 8) AS OWNER, r.OWNERTYPE FROM SYSCAT.ROUTINEAUTH a JOIN SYSCAT.ROUTINES r ON r.ROUTINESCHEMA = a.SCHEMA AND r.SPECIFICNAME = a.SPECIFICNAME WHERE a.GRANTEE = 'PUBLIC' AND a.SCHEMA = 'SYSPROC' AND r.ROUTINENAME IN ('ADMIN_CMD', 'SYSTS_ADMIN_CMD', 'ADMIN_TASK_ADD', 'ADMIN_TASK_UPDATE', 'SNAP_WRITE_FILE', 'REMOTE_QUERY', 'DB2LOAD') ORDER BY 1

  7 record(s) selected.
